mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Payments returns one row per payment. Doctor totals aggregates a physician's payments into a single summary row (total received, top companies, by payment type) - the flagship view.

doctorLastName.title: Doctor last name
doctorLastName.description: Physician last name (exact, case-insensitive). Combine with first name and state to pin down a specific doctor.

companyName.title: Paying company contains
companyName.description: Manufacturer or GPO making the payment ("pfizer", "medtronic"). Partial match. Use this to pull all payments a company made.

state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter state of the physician ("CA", "TX"). Optional filter.

year.title: Program year
year.description: Which year's payments to search. Data is available for 2019 through the latest published year.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: In Payments mode, the max payment rows. In Doctor totals mode, the max doctors summarized.
